changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE condition_operands ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, project_id BIGINT NOT NULL, -- REFERENCES project.project_id operand VARCHAR(55) NOT NULL, operand_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, operand_subject VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, is_deleted TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
CONSTRAINT uk_condition_operands UNIQUE (project_id, operand, operand_type, operand_subject, is_deleted) );

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda Nugraha
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO condition_operands (operand, operand_type, operand_subject, project_id, is_deleted) SELECT DISTINCT left(usco.operand, 55), left(usco.operand_type, 10), 'USER_SET', p.project_id, 0 FROM user_sets u LEFT JOIN user_set_conditions usc ON u.id = usc.user_set_id LEFT JOIN user_set_condition_operands usco ON usco.user_condition_set_id = usc.id LEFT JOIN projects p ON u.project_id = p.project_id;

changeSet.author: [Z4999972] Aditya Murda
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE user_set_condition_operands ADD COLUMN operand_id BIGINT NOT NULL;
UPDATE user_set_condition_operands r LEFT JOIN condition_operands t ON r.operand = t.operand AND r.operand_type = t.operand_type SET r.operand_id = t.id WHERE t.operand_subject = 'USER_SET';
